topic.title: How well does your CV track the public LB once external data and test-time grouping are involved?
topic.author: Meni David Gottesman

raw.title: How well does your CV track the public LB once external data and test-time grouping are involved?
How well does your CV track the public LB once external data and test-time grouping are involved?

firstMessage.content: For people whose CV and public LB still move together even with members trained on large external/generated pools and steps that use same-prompt groups at test time: how do you build your validation? Held-out data sources, simulated sparse same-prompt groups with distractors, scoring only on host passages, a second fold seed, something else? And roughly what CV-to-LB gap do you see?
